id_note: Fact ids start with the full service key (transit-gateway-, vpc-endpoints-, privatelink-, vpc-peering-) because M1 requires id to start with the service key; the plan prefixes tgw- and vpce- would fail M1.

d11-106.note: FAQ says identical CIDRs; the user guide (tgw-vpc-attachments) says identical or overlapping. Writers use the guide fact for the rule and the FAQ fact for the quick-fire quote.

d11-107.note: The TGW FAQ gives no limit values; it points to the documentation.

d11-110.note: FAQ vs guide: FAQ says up to 100 endpoints per VPC; vpc-limits-endpoints says 50 interface and Gateway Load Balancer endpoints per VPC and 20 gateway endpoints per Region (up to 255 per VPC). Both sides are in the canon (vpc-endpoints-faq-guide-quota-*). FAQ says peering is limited to 125 connections; the peering quotas page says default 50, adjustable up to 125 (vpc-peering-faq-guide-quota-active-per-vpc). The conflict queue did not queue these pairs (different claim wording), so this note is the record. Writers teach the guide numbers and may quote the FAQ as the older, rounder statement.

d11-111.note: FAQ vs guide: the FAQ says a service public endpoint name cannot be used to reach VPC endpoints (only private endpoint names); the guide says that with private DNS enabled on an interface endpoint for an AWS service, requests keep using the public service name. Teach the guide behavior; use the FAQ sentence only with that caveat.

d11-112.note: The FAQ security-group answer does not name an endpoint type; do not teach it as applying to gateway endpoints.

d11-113.note: On the saved PrivateLink FAQ page the answer under the question about Gateway Load Balancer endpoints repeats the resource and service-network endpoint text, so the GWLB sentence is quoted from the endpoint-types answer.

d11-114.note: FAQ vs FAQ: the VPC FAQ says Amazon VPC offers two endpoint types (gateway and interface); the PrivateLink FAQ says five. Five is current; two is the older text. The VPC FAQ list of services on PrivateLink (EC2, ELB, Kinesis Streams, Service Catalog, EC2 Systems Manager, SNS, DataSync) is out of date and was not added; use the guide page aws-services-privatelink-support.

d11-117.note: VPC Encryption Controls announced 2025-11 (before 2026-07-15, examinable); marked frequently-changing so a currency vote runs. The charge for TGW encryption is already in vpc-encryption-controls-tgw-charges-attached-vpcs.
